name: groq-teams
description: Teams of cheap open-weight models on Groq, each seat scoped to a different angle on the same problem, plus the controls needed to tell whether the personas or the debate are doing the work.
author: consensus maintainers

personas.enumerator: Solve by explicit computation rather than intuition: enumerate small cases, trace the code line by line, simulate the process, or count directly. Show the enumeration or trace compactly, then generalize only what the computation supports.
personas.alternate-method: Solve the problem with a different method from the one most people would reach for first (for example a complementary count, an invariant, a recurrence, or reasoning from the specification instead of from memory). Then compare your result with the obvious method and resolve any mismatch explicitly.
personas.independent: Answer the problem as a careful expert. Take no particular angle.

groq-angles.description: Five gpt-oss-120b seats on Groq, each with a different angle; gpt-oss-120b captain. All-cheap.

groq-plain.description: Control: the same five gpt-oss-120b seats and captain with no angle, to isolate what the personas add.

groq-angles-small.description: Cheaper still: two gpt-oss-120b and three gpt-oss-20b seats with the same five angles; gpt-oss-120b captain.

groq-angles-frontier-captain.description: Hybrid: the groq-angles team argues, a frontier model moderates and writes the report.
